paper_title: Searching for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with an 18T Magnet Haloscope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (converted from stated KSVZ coupling multiples using g_KSVZ ≈ 3.91e-16 * m_a[ueV] GeV^-1)
notes: CAPP18T haloscope, 18T HTS magnet, TM010 cavity, scan 4.7789-4.8094 GHz. Limits quoted only as multiples of KSVZ coupling: 1.5x KSVZ over 19.764-19.771 ueV, 2.7x KSVZ over 19.772-19.863 ueV (shallow scan), 1.7x KSVZ over 19.863-19.890 ueV.
